title: Reject unrecognized flags in atelier-axi commands (AXI principle 6)
description: Commands parse args with args.includes()/flagValue() so a typo'd flag is silently ignored instead of failing loudly. AXI principle 6 requires failing on unrecognized flags. Safety edge: 'share --pasword x' silently publishes a PUBLIC page when the user meant private. Add a shared assertKnownFlags(args, allowed) helper and wire it into each command's arg parsing.

title: Rebrand project from lavish to atelier
description: Rename CLI/package (lavish-axi->atelier-axi), env vars (LAVISH_AXI_*->ATELIER_AXI_*), DOM contract (window.lavish, data-lavish-*, lavish:* events), state/artifact dirs, product name Lavish Editor->Atelier Editor, skill dirs, marketing site, vendored lavish-design skill, repo URLs. Clean break (no aliases). Leave frozen historical records (CHANGELOG, evidence, docs) untouched. App must pass pnpm run check.
close_reason: Rebranded lavish->atelier across app code, skills, marketing, and vendored design skill. All 457 tests + build/lint/format/typecheck/skill-freshness pass; live CLI smoke test confirms /health app=atelier-axi, window.atelier/atelier:* SDK contract, atelier-session bootstrap, and end/stop lifecycle.

title: Document upstream-sync procedure for the lavish-axi fork
description: atelier-axi is a hard-rebrand fork of kunchenguid/lavish-axi. Add a maintainer doc (docs/upstream-sync.md) capturing the PR-based, plain-merge-commit upstream sync workflow, the rebrand-conflict expectations, and the no-mistakes gate interaction (own-fork sync PRs admin-merge past the red Require no-mistakes check).

title: Skill: headless (chat-only) plan mode to save tokens / quick planning
description: Add a lightweight planning variant to skills/atelier/planning.md, triggered by explicit phrases ('quick plan', 'plan without UI', 'headless plan', 'plan in chat'). In this mode skip the HTML artifact + atelier-axi poll loop (Phases 3-4); instead run a chat-based intake: present all Phase-1 questions batched in one numbered message, user answers in one reply, then targeted follow-ups only. Still classify large/small (Phase 2), propose 2-3 approaches in chat with a recommendation, keep the explicit approve-the-design gate, then run Phases 5-8 unchanged (spec.md+plan.md large route, plan.md small route, beads records, git commit). Advertise in the static 'Choose your mode' block in src/skill.js and regenerate SKILL.md via build:skill. Files: skills/atelier/planning.md, src/skill.js, skills/atelier/SKILL.md (generated).

title: WebUI: 'Queue all answers' button batches every filled-in input card in one action
description: Today the artifact WebUI queues one input/question card at a time (each form's own Queue button). Add a window.atelier.queueAll() SDK helper so an artifact can offer a single 'Queue all answers' button that triggers every [data-atelier-question] form's submit (reusing each per-question onsubmit -> queuePrompt), plus an atelier:submit event escape hatch for custom non-form question UIs. Optional {send:true} also fires sendQueuedPrompts(). Document in the input playbook. Files: src/artifact-sdk.js (helper + public API), src/playbooks.js (input playbook docs), tests.

title: Consolidate atelier-plan + atelier-implement into single atelier skill
description: Remove selection ambiguity: fold atelier-plan and atelier-implement into one atelier skill using on-demand reference files (planning.md, implementing.md) under skills/atelier/. Core generated SKILL.md gains a mode-routing section carrying the docs/atelier/<date>-<type>-<topic>/ output path (fixes earlier bug where spec/plan landed outside docs/atelier). Delete the two separate skill dirs; move plan-template.md + review-rubrics.md; update package.json files, tests, README, CLAUDE.md.

title: Truncate dom_snapshot in poll output with --full escape hatch (AXI principle 3)
description: Poll output returns dom_snapshot verbatim and un-truncated (cli.js), plus prompt text. AXI principle 3 requires truncating large text with a size hint and a --full flag to bypass. Add default truncation of dom_snapshot with a byte-size hint, and a poll --full flag that returns the full snapshot.

title: Weave TDD + engineering principles + treehouse worktrees into the planner
description: Adjust the lavish feature planner workflow per user direction. (1) Enforce TDD rigor (Iron Law: no production code without a failing test first; RED -> watch it fail -> GREEN minimal -> verify -> REFACTOR; exceptions for prototypes/generated/config need user OK) authored fresh (no dependency on vendored .agents skills). (2) Weave four principles into lavish-plan + lavish-implement: TDD-first, systematic-over-ad-hoc, complexity-reduction, evidence-over-claims. (3) When implementation begins, acquire an isolated dev worktree via 'treehouse get --lease' (fallback: git worktree add, then feature branch) so work happens on a branch first for parallel dev; return it when done. (4) Commit durable records before the implement hand-off so a fresh worktree has plan.md. Portability: graceful degradation when treehouse absent. Keep pnpm run check green.
close_reason: Implemented TDD Iron Law + 4 engineering principles + treehouse dev-worktree flow (fallback git worktree/branch) + commit-records-before-handoff across lavish-plan, lavish-implement, plan-template; test-first packaging anchors. Commit 2069017. pnpm run check exit 0.

title: Post-review hardening for lavish feature planner
description: Implement 5 review-driven improvements + reconcile a new Phase 1 contradiction. (1) Warn/guard against duplicate data-lavish-question collisions in the plan playbook decision-card template (silent prompt overwrite). (2) Add a 'Decisions resolved during review' section to plan-template.md so small-route decisions survive without review.html. (3) Bake layout-safety guards into the decision-card template + design_rules note (overflow-x, min-width:0). (4) Add structural regression test for the decision-card template in test/cli-output.test.js. (5) Rename durable output root docs/atelier-plans -> docs/plans for portability across spec/skill/plan/prompt. (6) Reconcile SKILL.md Phase 1 (still says 'terminal interview, one question at a time') with the new 'surface questions in the UI' operating rule.
close_reason: Implemented all 5 review recommendations + the structural test; small-route reconciliation and check-green cleanup committed. #1/#3 (decision-card key + layout guards) landed via the playbook; #2/#4/#5 in commits 06e4405 + 1a6079c. pnpm run check exit 0, 457 tests.
